definition.description: This flow starts when manually triggered. It sets up several values to track progress and status. It then processes a list of resources provided in the trigger, iterating through each item in the list. For every resource, it extracts a specific identifier. The flow is structured so that each step only runs after the previous one succeeds, ensuring a clear and reliable sequence. The main purpose is to prepare, loop through, and handle each resource in a controlled manner, making it suitable for batch processing or automation tasks involving multiple items.
